scope: Defines only how an already-admitted four-component soft flower-colour vector would become the TTF within-species edge-turnover response. It does not authorize measurement, colour access, TTF empirical inference, or interpretation.
preconditions_for_use: the separately frozen v0.9 postmeasurement support gate must pass
the exact postmeasurement classifiable geometry must pass the separately authorized synthetic requalification
a separate colour-unseal and empirical-TTF authorization must exist

measurement_representation.source: The unchanged FCP qualified ROI-v4 + EfficientSAM fixed-palette measurement collapsed to the pre-existing four-component probability vector.
measurement_representation.required_domain: each component finite and >=0; vector sum equals one within absolute tolerance 1e-8
measurement_representation.missing_or_unclassifiable_rows: remain missing and are governed by the separately frozen support/missingness firewall; never impute, replace, or assign a colour class

primary_edge_dissimilarity.name: jensen_shannon_divergence_four_component_soft_colour
primary_edge_dissimilarity.definition: For probability vectors p and q, let m=(p+q)/2 and JSD(p,q)=0.5*KL(p||m)+0.5*KL(q||m), using natural logarithms and the convention 0*log(0/x)=0.
properties_used_for_preregistration: finite and bounded for probability vectors, including zero components
uses the complete soft colour composition rather than a post-hoc categorical threshold
matches the already frozen FCP reserve measurement/replication representation without using any reserve outcome
primary_edge_dissimilarity.square_root_variant: not a separate sensitivity: sqrt(JSD) is a strictly increasing transform on nonnegative JSD, and TTF rank-normalizes edge dissimilarities within species, so it produces the same within-species turnover ranks apart from exact numerical ties
primary_edge_dissimilarity.log_base: natural log; another fixed log base would only multiply JSD by a positive constant and therefore would not change TTF within-species edge ranks
primary_edge_dissimilarity.alternative_colour_distances: not selectable after colour opening. Hellinger, Euclidean, categorical mismatch, hue-axis embeddings, or learned distances require a new pre-outcome study and cannot rescue a failed empirical TTF result.

ttf_mapping.edge_graph: the exact frozen kNN graph of the postmeasurement classifiable geometry under the separately qualified deployment contract
ttf_mapping.raw_edge_value: JSD between the two endpoint four-component colour vectors
ttf_mapping.within_species_response: rank01(raw_edge_value), identical to the existing TTF edge_turnover rank convention
ttf_mapping.training_response: apply the frozen training-side edge-length rank orthogonalization to the within-species turnover ranks
ttf_mapping.evaluation_response: leave the within-species turnover ranks unchanged, preserving the frozen raw held-out Spearman estimand
ttf_mapping.private_strength: compute only from the frozen training response using the existing training-only edge-midpoint neighbour coherence statistic

empirical_primary_estimand.question: Does a colour-turnover field learned from the frozen training species predict within-species colour turnover in unseen held-out species beyond the species-private baseline compatible with training-only private spatial strength?
empirical_primary_estimand.statistic: the same frozen raw held-out macro transfer statistic T used by the v0.8/v0.9 synthetic qualification
empirical_primary_estimand.inference: the same frozen profiled-private reference procedure; no empirical-data threshold tuning
empirical_primary_estimand.species_split: must remain the postmeasurement-qualified seed-20260920 125/125 species split if all 250 species pass the support gate

claim_ceiling.pass_can_support: Evidence that soft flower-colour turnover contains a cross-species transferable spatial component within the exact admitted iNaturalist reserve frame and frozen measurement/design pipeline.
pass_cannot_by_itself_support: independence from all systematic photographic or habitat structure
claim_ceiling.non_rejection: does not establish absence of shared colour structure; interpretation remains conditional on the frozen design adequacy and measurement-support gates
